notes.subject: את (×2)
notes.rationale: Ndarangĩri ya kĩndũ gĩgĩthĩnjwo nĩyo yĩrũmagĩrĩra ⟨את⟩, ndĩtaũrwo.

notes.subject: התמיד
notes.rationale: 'theri' nĩ gũtaũra kũrĩ kũmwe kwa 'continual'; KJV 'daily sacrifice' nĩ kũongeretha 'sacrifice'.

notes.subject: השקוץ משומם
notes.rationale: 'kĩgũrũ kĩrĩa gĩtherembũrĩte' — kiugo kĩa nomo: shiqutz meshomem; arĩa me ta Kĩrĩkanĩro Kĩerũ meigire 'abomination of desolation', handũ ha gũtaũra ũrĩa Kĩhibirania kiugĩte.

notes.subject: kĩgũrũ kĩrĩa gĩtherembũrĩte
notes.rationale: Kiugo gĩkũũ nĩ gĩa kũũmba thayũ — kĩndũ gĩtigĩrĩire gũtuũka kĩũndũ gĩtigĩmenyeka kĩrĩa kĩambĩrĩria.

notes.subject: שקוץ/משומם
notes.rationale: Mĩthagathagano ya mĩgambo igĩrĩ ũturĩkie wa kiugo — ithenya rĩa makũrũ mathĩũ, rĩrĩa rĩagĩrĩkuo kĩuno nĩgũo kũoneka.

translation: Na mĩhang'o kuuma kwa-yarĩ ĩgĩikara; makĩgĩthĩnja ⟨את⟩ mũtheru, mũkũrũ wa hinya, makĩruta ⟨את⟩ kĩheo-gĩa-theri, makĩgĩcĩra ⟨את⟩ kĩgũrũ kĩrĩa gĩtherembũrĩte.
